commits_data.title: [WIP] TCP: Fix conversation overlapping when reusing ports
commits_data.message:
[WIP] TCP: Fix conversation overlapping when reusing ports

When reusing both TCP ports on a new conversation, packets from
one side could be associated to a previous conversation already
considered as finished. Also changes the way conversations are
updated for keeping the last_frame info. Closes #15097.
